```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class TagEditComponent extends Component
{
    // Public Properties
    public $tagId;
    public $tagName = '';
    public $noteId;

    // Basic Methods
    public function mount($id)
    {
        $this->tagId = $id;
        $this->loadTag();
    }

    private function loadTag()
    {
        $tag = \App\Models\Tag::find($this->tagId);
        if ($tag) {
            $this->tagName = $tag->name;
        }
    }

    public function saveTag()
    {
        $note = \App\Models\Note::where('id', $this->noteId)->first();
        if ($note && Auth::user()->can('edit note tags')) {
            $tag = \App\Models\Tag::create(['name' => $this->tagName]);
            $note->tags()->attach($tag);
            $this->resetForm();
        }
    }

    public function deleteTag()
    {
        $note = \App\Models\Note::where('id', $this->noteId)->first();
        if ($note && Auth::user()->can('edit note tags')) {
            $note->tags()->detach(Auth::user()->default_tag);
            $this->resetForm();
        }
    }

    public function resetForm()
    {
        $this->tagId = null;
        $this->tagName = '';
        $this->noteId = null;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.tag-edit-component');
    }
}
```
